description: This file defines an interface 'ThingCommand' representing commands related to a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constant definitions, default method implementations, and a nested class 'JsonFields' that specifies JSON field definitions for serialization.

classes.name: ThingCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions specific to ThingCommand's JSON representation.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix for Thing commands, combining 'things.' with a type qualifier.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the EntityId associated with the Thing, delegating to getThingEntityId().

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for Thing entities.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type of the Thing, specifically ThingConstants.ENTITY_TYPE.
